body.x: Patchworks(www.patchworksonline.com)announced Colorant ITG Pro at 'Showstoppers' of CES 2014, the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
There are two products Patchworks introduced. One is 'ITG Pro', the other is 'Link Pro'.

'ITG Pro' has super tempered glass, which will provide users 93.7% transparency. Also, it is resistant to oil, dust, and fingerprints greatly while keeping a crystal clear transparency. In addition, if broken, the protector breaks into small pieces that are not sharp, making it safer than other glass products.

'Link Pro' yields dual protection structure. Beautifully designed outer protection against major shocks, while inner TPU protection for your phone's safety even from small shock. All embedded holes are blocked in Link Pro case, which will resist against dirt fill-ups, or water splashes. Also Link Pro has linking system, which holds more than 400 pounds of weight, and attaches automatically to the holder with magnetic force. In addition, when you detach from the holder, all you need is a click of a button.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
